WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
all_accounts_with_counts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COALESCE(oc.order_count, 0) as order_count
  FROM account a
  LEFT JOIN order_counts oc ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
),
average_all AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_all_accounts
  FROM all_accounts_with_counts
),
above_average_accounts AS (
  SELECT aawc.account_id, aawc.order_count
  FROM all_accounts_with_counts aawc, average_all aa
  WHERE aawc.order_count > aa.avg_all_accounts
),
average_above_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_above_average
  FROM above_average_accounts
)
SELECT 
  aaa.account_id,
  aaa.order_count,
  aaa.order_count - ava.avg_all_accounts,
  aaa.order_count - avaa.avg_above_average
FROM above_average_accounts aaa, average_all ava, average_above_average avaa
ORDER BY (aaa.order_count - avaa.avg_above_average) DESC
LIMIT 10;
